# Credits

## Swarm, by Joel Califa

The idea and the motion design are **Joel Califa's**: <https://joelcalifa.com> ·
<https://califa.github.io/swarm-site/> · [@califa](https://github.com/califa).

Swarm is a website that builds itself as you scroll. Large parts of the animation engine in
`swarm-cursors/assets/swarm-cursors.js` are adapted from his site: the set of named multiplayer
cursors and their colors, the swarm and flocking physics, the build choreography (boxes, typing,
guides, duplicates), the rulers, and the overall look.

What this project adds on top: the code that snapshots *any* live page into something the swarm can rebuild
(from the Swarm Rebuild browser extension), and the website packaging and Claude skill around it
(trigger button, hotkey, auto-play, per-page targeting, installer, verifier, platform guides).

Go look at the original. It's better than this.

## Other

- The Swarm Rebuild extension this engine was packaged from: <https://github.com/DhvanilPatel/swarm-cursors>
